name: cws-planning
description: CWS Planning-app voor Cloudflare Pages Functions en D1.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:syntax && npm run lint:security
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.120.0 pages dev dist --port=8788 --local
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx --yes wrangler@4.120.0 d1 migrations apply cws-planning-intern --local --persist-to=.wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx --yes wrangler@4.120.0 d1 migrations apply cws-planning-intern --remote
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:static && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.deploy: npm run verify && npx --yes wrangler@4.120.0 pages deploy dist --project-name=cws-planning-intern
